blurb: Whether you come on your own or with family, Cruise Orange Beach welcomes you on an exciting dolphin tour! The fun begins with a relaxing ride through the back bays of Orange Beach, where you can take in the beautiful scenery of the area. Along the way, you may encounter local marine wildlife - including dolphins, of course.
